title: S.E.M. 2027
subtitle: 12-Week ATHX 2027 Performance Programme
tagline: Build strength. Hold output. Finish the work.
purpose: Prepare athletes for the published ATHX 2027 Strength, Endurance and MetCon X workouts while improving real strength, aerobic performance, muscle and race execution.

independent_disclaimer: S.E.M. 2027 is produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. It is designed for athletes preparing for ATHX but is not produced, approved or endorsed by ATHX. The current official workout page, final athlete briefing and judge instructions always override this programme.

official_2027.status: Official workout page live; 2027 movement standards not yet linked or published on the ATHX site at check date.

individual.details: 10-12 warm-up; two 1-min lift windows separated by 1 min. Three continuous reps or three singles inside the minute.

pairs.details: Athlete A: 2-min warm-up, two 1-min lift windows separated by 1 min. Then 2-min warm-up for Athlete B and the same two windows.

strength.score: Sum of all three components. ATHX states the deadlift score is the average of the two lifts; verify the final event briefing for pairs aggregation detail.

endurance.score: Total SkiErg distance completed after the set-distance run.

pairs.rule: Both athletes start the run together. The first athlete to finish may begin skiing immediately.

lite.status: Not listed on the official 2027 workout page at check date.

metcon_x.score: Time to complete inside the 25-minute cap.

lite.status: Not listed on the official 2027 workout page at check date.

pairs.split_status: The 2027 workout page publishes team volumes but not complete changeover, mixed-load or movement-standard rules. The final ATHX briefing overrides this manifest.

training_load_levels.L1: 40-55% event load - learn positions and safe transitions.
training_load_levels.L4: 100% published category load - short clusters, rehearsal and race.

programme_rules: Complete Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday core sessions in order where possible.
Thursday or Sunday recovery/education is optional and never lowers core completion.
BUILD alternatives replace the named main block; they are never additional work.
No missed strength repetitions in normal training.
Do not cram missed hard sessions or repeat rehearsals.
Week 10 contains the only full-zone major simulation.
Weeks 11-12 retain brief intensity while volume falls.
Latest official ATHX information overrides cached app and PDF copy.

sessions.title: Shoulder-to-overhead baseline + upper muscle

blocks.name: Prepare
blocks.instruction: 8-12 min easy row or SkiErg, shoulders and thoracic spine, then progressive empty-bar shoulder-to-overhead practice.
blocks.standard: The first work set should feel prepared, not surprising.

blocks.name: Shoulder-to-overhead
blocks.instruction: Practise strict press, push press and push jerk with light load. Select the method you can control today. Work to 1 single at RPE 8, then 4 x 3 at RPE 7 using that method. No max attempt.
blocks.standard: No missed reps in normal training. Stop when position or speed changes materially.

blocks.name: Secondary strength
blocks.instruction: DB bench press 3 x 10 at RPE 7. Rest 90 sec. Use the same dumbbell setup you can control on a flat bench.
blocks.standard: No missed reps in normal training. Stop when position or speed changes materially.

blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 4 x 10, lateral raise 3 x 12-15 and cable or band triceps press-down 3 x 12-15.

blocks.name: Record

sessions.title: Official-format endurance baseline
sessions.purpose: Measure current run-to-Ski performance inside the real 24-minute structure.

blocks.name: Prepare
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run, dynamic calf and hip prep, 3 relaxed strides, then 3-5 min easy SkiErg.
blocks.standard: The first work set should feel prepared, not surprising.

blocks.name: Run
blocks.instruction: Lite Pairs: 2.4 km. ATHX and Pro: 3 km. Run at RPE 8-8.5 with an even first kilometre. Individual Lite is not currently listed by ATHX; do not invent a race prescription.
blocks.standard: Keep the first repetition controlled and preserve repeatable mechanics.

blocks.name: Run-to-Ski
blocks.instruction: Move directly to the SkiErg and accumulate distance until 24:00. Start 5-10 sec per 500 m calmer than fresh Ski pace, then build only if stroke length holds.
blocks.standard: Use a sustainable stroke rate and return the handles under control.

blocks.name: BUILD alternative
blocks.instruction: Use 3 x 6 min at RPE 7: 4 min run + 2 min SkiErg, with 2 min easy between rounds. Choose this if a continuous event-format effort is not yet appropriate.
blocks.standard: Keep the first repetition controlled and preserve repeatable mechanics.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the named block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Log run time and kilometre splits, transition time, Ski distance, average /500 m and final RPE.
blocks.standard: Record the result before leaving the session.

sessions.coach_note: The baseline is a decision tool. An even run that leaves usable Ski output is better than a fast run followed by collapse.
